area_control.claim.how_to:
To claim a area, you need a(n) %1$s. You need to hold this item and use it on the lower-left corner of the area you would like to claim. 
Then, do the same on the upper-right corner of the area you would like to claim. Finally, execute command /ac claim.
You may also use /ac claim chunk to claim one or more chunks.
Servers may apply additional rules. In case of conflicts, ask your server op.

When ON, players can break blocks.

When ON, players can click blocks. Also colloquially known as left-clicking blocks.

When ON, players can interact with other entities.

When ON, players can place blocks.

When ON, players can hold items in their inventories.
Allow PvP
When enabled, players can attack other players.
Allow Riding
When ON, players can ride on other entities.
Allow C.B. Selecting From Child Area
When ON, entity selectors in a command block can select entities in child areas.

When ON, entity selectors used by an entity (including player) can select entities in child areas.

When ON, entity selectors in a command block can select entities in parent areas.

When ON, entity selectors used by an entity (including player) can select entities in parent areas.
